description: This Java source file defines the class TreeBasedPolicyAlgorithm, which implements the PolicyAlgorithm interface to evaluate and enforce policies using a tree-based policy enforcer within the Eclipse Ditto framework. The class provides methods for checking permissions, retrieving subjects with specific permissions, and building JSON views based on policies.

classes.name: TreeBasedPolicyAlgorithm
classes.description: Implements policy evaluation functions using a tree-based policy evaluator within the Eclipse Ditto framework.

methods.name: TreeBasedPolicyAlgorithm
methods.description: Constructor that initializes the policy algorithm with a given policy.

methods.name: hasUnrestrictedPermissions
methods.description: Checks if a resource has unrestricted permissions for a given authorization context and permissions.

methods.name: getSubjectIdsWithPermission
methods.description: Retrieves subject IDs with a specific permission on a resource.

methods.name: getSubjectsWithPermission
methods.description: Retrieves subject entities with a specific permission on a resource.

methods.name: getSubjectIdsWithPartialPermission
methods.description: Retrieves subject IDs with partial permissions on a resource.

methods.name: getSubjectsWithPartialPermission
methods.description: Retrieves subjects with partial permissions on a resource.

methods.name: hasPartialPermissions
methods.description: Checks if there are partial permissions for a resource in a given authorization context.

methods.name: buildJsonView
methods.description: Builds a JSON object view of a resource with respect to permissions and authorization context.
